title: Research Methodology
shortDescription: Understand the fundamentals of research step by step.
description: A comprehensive foundation course covering research design, hypothesis formulation, sampling techniques, and data collection strategies for clinical and academic research.

title: Research Proposal Writing
shortDescription: Write strong, ethical and fundable research proposals.
description: Learn to craft compelling, ethically sound research proposals that meet institutional review board and funding body standards.

title: Biostatistics using SPSS
shortDescription: Master data analysis and interpretation with SPSS.
description: Hands-on training in descriptive and inferential biostatistics using SPSS, including hypothesis testing, regression, and reporting.

title: Scientific Writing
shortDescription: Write publications with clarity, impact and precision.
description: Develop the skills to write clear, structured, and publication-ready scientific manuscripts for peer-reviewed journals.

title: Systematic Review & Meta-analysis
shortDescription: Conduct high-quality reviews and meta-analyses step by step.
description: A rigorous course on PRISMA-guided systematic review methodology and meta-analytic techniques using standard software.
